title: Racks and shelves
purpose: Find racks, towers, shelves and canisters across all storage units. Each one holds either other shelves or racks, or boxes.

sections.title: Search, filters and sorting
paragraphs: Search matches part of the code or name, ignoring capitals.
Without a status filter only active racks and shelves are listed.
Click a sortable column heading to sort by it; click again to reverse. Ties keep a stable order. Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows per page; the default is 25.

items.label: Free positions
items.description: Any, Has free positions, or No free positions, counting everything inside it.

items.label: Site, Room
items.description: Limit by where the unit stands.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active (the default), Retired, or Active and retired.

items.label: Code
items.description: Immutable code; opens the page. Always shown.

items.label: Location
items.description: Path of codes from the top of the unit to this node. Sortable.

items.label: Slot
items.description: Its numbered place in the unit or in its parent.

items.label: Holds
items.description: Node slots or box slots it offers.

items.label: Positions, Occupied, Free
items.description: Counts for the whole node including everything under it. Position counts cover positions in active boxes that sit in active racks, shelves and storage units. Retired structure is never counted as capacity. Installed is every such position; Blocked are positions held out of use; Occupied have an item stored in them; Free is installed minus blocked minus occupied. Free positions are not reserved: a position is claimed only when an item is stored in it.

items.label: Status
items.description: Active, or Retired once the record has been retired.

items.label: Export CSV
items.description: Downloads the rows that match the current search, filters and sort as a UTF-8 CSV file. Any role that can read this list can download it. A selection of more than 10,000 rows is refused rather than cut short: narrow the filters and export again. Cells that a spreadsheet could read as a formula are prefixed with an apostrophe, and numbers are exact decimals. Each download is recorded in the audit trail with who exported which selection and how many rows, never the file itself.

items.label: New rack or shelf
items.description: Opens the create form. Shown only to the admin and manager roles.

items.label: No records yet
items.description: Shown when nothing has been defined. Users who may create records see the create button in the message.

items.label: Nothing matches these filters
items.description: The search or filters exclude every row. Change or clear them.

items.label: These filters cannot be applied
items.description: A filter value was not valid. The list shows no rows rather than all rows; correct the highlighted filter.
